formŭlārĭus , ii, m. formula, II. C.,
I.a lawyer skilled only in composing writs or forms of process in courts of law: “alii se ad album ac rubricas transtulerunt et formularii vel, ut Cicero ait, leguleii quidam esse maluerunt, etc.,” Quint. 12, 3, 11 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
